GITX_CACHE.investigation_focus: Check cache invalidation rate, which accounts are causing excessive invalidations, and whether GITX_NEW_CACHE_STRATEGY FF is enabled

GITX_WEBHOOK.investigation_focus: Check P95 webhook processing time, cache hit rate correlation, queue backlog, and stalled accounts

GITX_INVALIDATE.investigation_focus: Check invalidation rate and source, whether a specific account is triggering excessive invalidations

GITX_EVENTS.investigation_focus: Check event queue health, whether events are being produced but not consumed

LOG_SERVICE_LATENCY.investigation_focus: Check log-service latency, ClickHouse health, Kafka consumer lag for log-service topics

LOG_SERVICE_ERRORS.investigation_focus: Check error rate, recent log-service deployments, ClickHouse connectivity

KAFKA_LAG.investigation_focus: Check consumer lag per topic, event processing rate, dead letter queue, consumer failure count

THREAD_POOL.investigation_focus: Check thread pool queued task count, execution count spike, top accounts driving load

JVM_THREADS.investigation_focus: Check JVM thread count trend, thread pool saturation, execution spike correlation

DW_THREADS.investigation_focus: Check Dropwizard thread count, usually informational

POD_RESTART.investigation_focus: Check restart causes (OOM, liveness probe timeout, dependency timeouts during startup). If liveness probe kill detected, search for RedisTimeoutException/Kafka/MongoDB errors between 'Starting Pipeline Service Application' and 'Shutdown hook' — slow dependency init is the root cause, not the probe. Also check JFR $POD_NAME race condition (Error termination reason). Common restart patterns from Confluence page 23216685217

REDIS_MEMORY.investigation_focus: Check Redis memory and CPU usage, event queued time, dead letter queue growth

PLAN_CREATION.investigation_focus: Check plan creation time P95, failed plan creation per module, downstream service health

EVENT_QUEUE.investigation_focus: Check avg event queued time per stream, event processing time, dead letter queue, consumer errors

ITERATOR_DELAY.investigation_focus: Check iterator processing delay and throughput

MONGODB.investigation_focus: Check MongoDB cluster health via codepulse db list, MongoDB CPU in Grafana, GCP logs for connection errors

DATASOURCE_ERROR.investigation_focus: Grafana datasource issue - check if the underlying metric source is healthy

REDIS_CONSUMER_LAG.investigation_focus: Check Redis stream consumer group lag. IMPORTANT: use label environment= (not namespace=) for Redis stream metrics — e.g. redis_streams_consumer_group_behind_by_count{environment='prod2'}. Primary root cause: JVM stop-the-world GC pause on pipeline-service (10+ min of complete log silence → readiness probes fail → pod removed from Service endpoints → consumer threads stop → backlog builds). Look for a log gap on pipeline-service matching the alert window. Note: cd and iacm consumers often show persistent lag of ~4k-5k on prod — this is a known baseline (dead consumers, pre-existing), not an active incident.

GCP_LOG_ALERT.investigation_focus: GCP log-based alert - check GCP logs for the specific error pattern

_env_note: For GCP details (namespace, project, cluster), refer to pipeline-service/.claude/config/gcp-environments.json as the source of truth. The promql_namespace below is the Prometheus metric label value; gcp_namespace is for GCP log queries.
